Since green→red failed, let me try red→green: red (cols 22, 28, 40) = O, p, R; green (cols 22, 28, 34, 40) = b, N, Y, M.

Target: green = b, N, Y, M; red = O, p, R.

- O: green col 22 → red col 22

- R: green col 34 → red col 40
- b: green col 40 → green col 22
- N: red col 22 → green col 28
- Y: red col 28 → green col 34
